extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance data are in Figure 5. Figure 5d (TOFMeOH, h−1) was digitised and retained in the notes of the corresponding records because the schema has no dedicated TOF field; Figure 5c is used for the methanol STY field. Figures 1–4 and 6–7 are characterisation/mechanism figures and were not extracted as catalytic performance data. The paper states that experimental details are in the supporting information; the main text/caption provides P = 3 MPa and GHSV = 12,000 mL/(g·h), but not the H2/CO2 feed ratio or catalyst mass.
